sentences.en: I think kayaking is a lot more fun than canoeing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得皮划艇比独木舟更有趣。

sentences.en: Wetlands are also great spots for fishing, canoeing, hiking and bird-watching.
sentences.zh: 湿地也是钓鱼、划独木舟、远足和观鸟的好地方。

sentences.en: A big canoe was cutting through the water.
sentences.zh: 一艘大独木舟正劈波斩浪。
